description: MO (Modus Operandi) slot schema for FIR Intel. Each crime type defines the structured slots that an extraction prompt must attempt to fill from the narrative. All populated slot values must include a verbatim 'quote' from the narrative (Rule 4).

cyber_fraud_kyc.description: How the fraudster contacted the victim (e.g. 'phone call', 'WhatsApp message')
Stated reason for contact (e.g. 'KYC expiry', 'reward points expiry')
Technique used to gain access (e.g. 'AnyDesk install', 'OTP share', 'APK install', 'screen share')
Role claimed by the fraudster (e.g. 'bank executive')
Amount transferred or debited in INR
Phone number used by the accused

fake_police_call.description: How the fraudster contacted the victim
Stated reason (e.g. 'Aadhaar linked to money laundering', 'parcel with illegal items')
How victim was coerced (e.g. 'video call', 'threat of arrest')
UPI ID or bank account where money was sent
Phone number used by the accused

job_scam.description: Type of job offered (e.g. 'part time task based job', 'data entry work from home')
What was asked from victim (e.g. 'security deposit', 'registration fee')
Phone number or WhatsApp number of the accused

atm_card_swap.description: How the swap was executed (e.g. 'offered to guide', 'offered help', 'exchanged card')
Whether PIN was observed by the accused
Amount withdrawn using the swapped card
Vehicle and registration used for escape if mentioned

chain_snatching.description: What the victim was doing (e.g. 'returning from the temple', 'shopping at the evening market')
Vehicle used by accused (make, colour, partial registration if mentioned)
How accused approached (e.g. 'asked for an address', 'came close from behind')

house_burglary.description: How entry was made (e.g. 'broke the lock with an iron rod', 'cut the window grill')
Why the house was unoccupied (e.g. 'family out of town', 'attending a wedding')
Items stolen (e.g. 'cash, jewellery and a television')
Estimated value of stolen property in INR

vehicle_theft.description: Type and make of vehicle (e.g. 'Hero Splendor', 'Bajaj Pulsar')
How the vehicle was taken (e.g. 'taken away on a small loader', 'broke the handle lock')
